reviewScope: All five dimensional sheets visually reviewed. This supplement records magnetic poles and location ordinates, Hall-sensor sections, antenna metal exclusions, button/port/acoustic references, front/rear mechanical locations, camera plateau profiles, body profiles and general notes. Existing base geometry and previously reviewed sensor/aperture scalars remain separate. Independent ordinates do not define full curves; unlabelled magnet positions, shape extents, manufacturing tolerances and calibrated optical geometry remain unavailable.

reviewAudit.scopeLimit: All indexed drawing sheets reviewed; this is semantic transcription of explicit references, not complete CAD. Generic dimensionless multiplicities and unlabelled illustrated magnet sizes/locations are not promoted into measured geometry.

reviewScope: All five dimensional sheets visually reviewed.
